thread:
maria: heads up — seeing regression on long-context workloads. selector is dropping to fallback kernel for seq > 1024. need more granular logs (reason tags + minimal fields) so we can correlate with kv-cache behavior and batching heuristics.
ben: what exact fields would help? arch, seq bucket, batch_effective, kv_hit?
sasha: agree. keep it minimal first so ops logs don't explode. proposed fields: kernel_chosen, reason_list, seq_bucket (eg <64,64-256,256-1024,>1024), arch_hint, kv_hit_ratio, eff_batch_size, dp_id (decision-path id).
maria: perfect. also add a debug env flag set so we can turn on per-deploy. something like KPICK_LOG and KPICK_REASON.
ben: sample log format idea:
```text
[kpick] pid=2421 chosen=algo_conv reason="seq>1024,kv_low" seq_bucket=">1024" batch=1 eff_batch=1 arch="amd_gfx90a" kv_hit=0.12 score=0.88 dp_id=0x7f3 flags=KPICK_LOG|KPICK_REASON
```
kevin: +1. dp_id will let us tie into the sampling traces. also capture model_version so we can plot over rollouts.
maria: add model_version too. plan: roll logs for 1 week, then add telemetry event in Optimize (proto) to ship aggregated counts.
perf-ci: ping — can perf CI emit a weekly histogram for fallback frequency per model-version? that'll help automatic regression alerts.
chandra: for sampling: we should downsample normal seqs. proposal: sample 1/100 for seq<=256, 1/10 for 256<seq<=1024, 1/1 for seq>1024 unless KPICK_FORCE_FULL=1. also allow KPICK_DEBUG_USERS env list for targeted users.
sasha: i'll draft a small patch in my branch, adds env flags + log lines + unit test for string formatting. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4567 (draft)
maria: awesome — can you include a small parsing helper (<200 lines) so observability can ingest into Loki/Elastic without regex gymnastics?
sasha: yep, will include structured key=value style so it's parse-friendly.
kevin: i'll own the rollout to staging and watch the error budget. will post an initial dump by EOD tomorrow.
maria: scheduling 1hr triage tomorrow 10:00am PST to review the first batch of logs and see if kpicks map to perf drops. @kevin please add links in this thread.
perf-ci: noted — i'll wire histogram dashboards after we have a day's worth of logs. :eyes:
chandra: one caveat — be careful with kv_hit_ratio calc cost on hot path. i'll implement a lightweight sample-based kv probe rather than full scan.
ben: good call. low overhead is critical. we only need a few decimals for trend detection.
maria: thanks team. small, iterative: logs -> sampling tweak -> proto event -> aggregated dashboard. keep this thread updated with PRs and staging links.
